title: Outdoor air pollution (fine particles)
question: How polluted is the air people breathe outdoors?
metric: Annual mean concentration of fine particulate matter (PM2.5), weighted by where people live

source.citation: World Health Organization. Global Health Observatory: concentrations of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) (indicator SDGPM25).
source.licence: WHO Global Health Observatory data, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO (WHO data policy)

caveats: Modelled from satellites, ground monitors and chemical transport models.
Everyone breathes outdoor air, so this is a level of exposure for the whole population.
